requirement.evidence: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.
requirement.note: Relocation assistance is also stated: "If your landlord evicts you for certain reasons, they might have to help pay for your moving costs."

requirement.evidence: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.
requirement.note: The cap, the 2.87% figure for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027, and the Tenant Petition route are all stated. The claim that rent can be raised only once a year is not supported: the page says "each year" but does not say once.

key_value.evidence: 2.87 percent is the maximum allowable rent increase for the period of September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027.
key_value.note: The lesser-of 3% or 80% of CPI rule is also stated on the page.
